4/15/24, 9:21 AM Minnesota Senate

Minnesota State Senate

Labor Committee
Tuesday, March 26, 2024
12:30 PM, 1100 Minnesota Senate Bldg.

Minutes

Present: Senator Jennifer A. McEwen - Chair, Senator Grant Hauschild - Vice Chair, Senator Gene Dornink, Senator Glenn
H. Gruenhagen, Senator Robert J. Kupec, Senator Bill Lieske, Senator John Marty, Senator Clare Oumou Verbeten, Senator Sandra
L. Pappas, Senator Nathan Wesenberg

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Robert J. Kupec called the meeting to order at 12:36pm.

Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Chief Judge
Patricia J Milun

Chief Judge Patricia Mullen gave testimony on her resume, and role at the court.

Member discussion.

Senator Marty moved that Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Chief Judge
Patricia J Milun, be recommended for confirmation. - MOTION ADOPTED.

Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Judge
Deborah K Sundquist

Judge Deborah K. Sundquist gave testimony on her resume, and role at the court.

Member discussion.

Senator Marty moved that Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Judge
Deborah K Sundquist, be recommended for confirmation. - MOTION ADOPTED.

Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Judge Sean M
Quinn

Judge Sean M. Quinn gave testimony on his resume, and role at the court.

Member discussion.

Senator Marty moved that Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Judge Sean M
Quinn, be recommended for confirmation. - MOTION ADOPTED.
